chunks.cap: My test runner ran a design skill's launcher, and it downloaded a 17 MB binary.
A BINARY. From a design skill.
I used to fix this by rewriting skills in my own words. That made my designs look AI-made.
Now outside skills run as they are, with my rules in one place around them.
Before: the job folder and the shared rules, like free tools only.
Options: 3, and a fresh judge picks one, with the skill names hidden.
Guards: scripts run only in the sandbox. Nothing gets posted without my OK.
After: facts, links, accessibility and SEO. Never the style.
So that launcher became one line in FIXES.md. Banned by name, even --help.
Still testing. I'll share it here once it's ready:
